# Thirty-Sixth Parallel LLC

> Thirty-Sixth Parallel LLC is a New Mexico company that plans to provide psilocybin services under the New Mexico Medical Psilocybin Program once it is licensed. New Mexico services are pending licensure. Colorado sessions are available on a limited basis under Colorado's Natural Medicine Program. The name comes from the 36th parallel, the line of latitude that crosses northern New Mexico.

## Key facts

- Status: New Mexico services pending licensure under the New Mexico Medical Psilocybin Program, and New Mexico consultation requests not open yet; Colorado sessions available on a limited basis (no qualifying diagnosis required in Colorado)
- Owner: Dr. Anne Metz, who holds a Colorado Natural Medicine Facilitator in Training license (License No. NMIT.0000254). She does not hold a New Mexico psilocybin license
- Related business: Dr. Metz also owns Anne Metz LLC (https://annemetz.com), a counseling practice. Anne Metz LLC does not provide psilocybin services. All psilocybin services are provided through Thirty-Sixth Parallel LLC under the laws of the state where the provider is licensed
- New Mexico's program is medical and expected to begin in January 2027. Under the proposed rules, every participant needs a qualifying diagnosis: treatment-resistant depression, a substance use disorder (including cannabis or nicotine use disorders), PTSD, or end-of-life care
- New Mexico pricing has not been set; Colorado pricing available on inquiry
- Contact: anne@annemetz.com (including Colorado availability)
